title: GM TechLink - Using the NACS DC Adapter to Access the Tesla Supercharger Network
notes: GM dealer-bulletin site. Adapter bought through the myChevrolet/myCadillac/myGMC app (accessories); for all GM EVs with DC fast charging; names Blazer EV, Equinox EV, Silverado EV, Bolt EV/EUV, LYRIQ, Sierra EV; Spark EV excluded; no free offer mentioned.
